summary: Added a zero-axiom Lean 4 loop proving DM-DPP-01 chain lengths (132 aa mature, 588 aa precursor) and integer-bracketed mobility ratio (132/588)^(1/3) between 607/1000 and 608/1000 (nominal 0.61 below 610/1000) plus length-scale factor (132/588)^(1/6) between 779/1000 and 780/1000, sourced from sequences/sequence_links.json P07713 annotations. Python tests cross-check JSON and the same inequalities.
root_cause: DM-DPP-01 was confirmed in predictions/resolutions/inrepo-quick.json by hand arithmetic only; the repo had no machine-checked Lean certificate tying prediction_id to the registered rational mobility factors.
evidence: sequences/sequence_links.json drosophila_melanogaster dpp: precursor_length_aa=588, chain 457-588 length_aa=132, UniProt P07713
predictions/prediction_registry.json DM-DPP-01 quantitative_expectation: D_precursor/D_mature = (132/588)^(1/3) ≈ 0.61, length scale ≈ 0.78

argv: import re; from pathlib import Path; s=Path('morphoeval/lean/loops/Loop_prediction_DM_DPP_01_dpp_mobility_ratio.lean').read_text(); s=re.sub(r'--.*', '', s); assert not re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z_])sorry(?:Ax)?(?![A-Za-z_])', s); print('no sorry term')
